    SELECT DISTINCT b.business_id
    FROM "Business" b
    JOIN "Business_Hours" bh ON b.business_id = bh.business_id
    WHERE b.active = 'true'
      AND b.city = 'Phoenix'
      AND bh.opening_time >= '5PM'
)
SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(*) AS num_businesses
FROM opened_businesses ob
JOIN "Business_Categories" bc ON ob.business_id = bc.business_id
JOIN Categories c ON bc.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_name
ORDER BY num_businesses DESC
LIMIT 3;
